- 10–35 min: SOC 2 controls overview (scoping + evidence owners)
- 35–65 min: DPA clauses and data flow review
- 65–85 min: pen test intake & scope questions
- 85–90 min: next steps & action items

- Tue Nov 9 — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Nov 10 — 13:00–14:30 PT
